appStoreInformation.name: Goalfer
appStoreInformation.subtitle: Social Habit Tracking
appStoreInformation.promotionalText: 🎯 Build lasting habits with friends! Track streaks, share progress, and achieve goals together with social accountability.
appStoreInformation.description:
Transform your life with Goalfer - the social habit tracker that helps you build lasting routines through accountability, motivation, and community support.

🎯 BUILD HABITS THAT STICK
• Beautiful habit tracking with visual progress circles
• Smart streak counting and milestone celebrations
• 39+ habit categories: fitness, wellness, productivity, creativity
• Offline support with seamless cloud sync
• Customizable reminders and notifications

👥 SOCIAL ACCOUNTABILITY THAT WORKS
• Connect with friends for mutual motivation
• Real-time activity feed showing friends' progress
• Encourage friends with emoji reactions (❤️🔥🏅)
• Privacy controls - share what you want, when you want
• Friend challenges and group motivation

📊 INSIGHTS THAT INSPIRE
• Comprehensive analytics and progress charts
• Streak statistics and personal achievement records
• Weekly and monthly progress summaries
• Trend analysis to optimize your routine
• Achievement badges and milestone tracking

✨ WHY GOALFER WORKS:
• Social accountability increases success rates by 65%
• Beautiful, intuitive design makes tracking effortless
• Proven habit formation techniques built-in
• Community support when motivation is low
• Privacy-first approach - your data stays yours

🏆 PERFECT FOR:
• Fitness routines and workout consistency
• Wellness practices like meditation and journaling
• Productivity habits and skill development
• Creative projects and learning goals
• Daily self-care and mindfulness practices

Join thousands of users who've transformed their lives with Goalfer. Download now and start building the habits that will change everything!

🔒 Privacy & Security: Your data is encrypted and secure. We never sell your information. Full privacy controls included.

ageRating.rationale: Goalfer is designed for all ages and promotes positive habit formation. The app includes mild social networking features (friend connections and activity sharing) and user-generated content (habit names and progress sharing) that are moderated and family-friendly.

appReviewInformation.notes:
Goalfer is a social habit tracking app that helps users build lasting routines through accountability and community support.

KEY FEATURES TO TEST:
1. User Registration/Login - Create account with email/password
2. Habit Creation - Tap '+' to create habits from 39+ categories
3. Habit Tracking - Tap habits to mark complete, see streak counters
4. Social Features - Add friends via email, see activity feed
5. Analytics - View progress charts and statistics

TEST ACCOUNT (if needed):
- The app works without special accounts
- All features available after standard registration
- No premium features or subscriptions currently

PRIVACY & SAFETY:
- All user data is private by default
- Users control what they share with friends
- No inappropriate content or gambling mechanics
- Family-friendly design suitable for all ages

The app promotes positive behavior change and healthy habit formation through social accountability and progress tracking.
